Give a grouping result the feature ids of the MS1Match feature table

assign_feature_names.Rd

For a grouping result without feature ids. Each row gets the feature_name of the feature in feature_table with the same m/z and RT. Because both come from the same feature table, the values are identical; the tolerances only absorb rounding. Rows that match no feature, or more than one, get NA; two rows matching the same feature both get NA.

Usage

assign_feature_names(
  x,
  feature_table,
  mz_col = "mz",
  rt_col = "rt",
  rt_unit = c("sec", "min"),
  mz_tol = 0.001,
  rt_tol = 1
)

Arguments

x

Grouping result, one row per feature.

feature_table

The feature table MS1Match was run on (feature_name, mzmed/mz, rtmed/rt in seconds).

mz_col, rt_col

Names of the m/z and RT columns in x.

rt_unit

Unit of rt_col: "sec" (default) or "min".

mz_tol, rt_tol

Rounding tolerances (Da, seconds). Defaults 0.001, 1.

Value

x with a feature_name column and rt_col converted to seconds. A message reports how many rows were matched.
